lines.text: In the evening, a rich disciple named Joseph from Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a clean linen cloth and placed it in his own new tomb.
Joseph rolled a great log across the entrance, and Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat opposite the tomb.
The chief priests and Pharisees told Pilate that Jesus had said, 'I will come down from the cross,' and asked him to secure the tomb.

wrong_details.wrong: I will come down from the cross
wrong_details.true: After three days I will rise again

lines.text: Pilate told them to make the tomb as secure as they knew how, so they sealed the stone and posted the guard.
